'''June 2001 Melbourne tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 24 June 2001. Adam won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2552">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-melbourne-australia-26-06-2k1d2552/ melbourne-australia-26-06-2k1], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 1 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-melbourne-australia-26-06-2k1d2552/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' Adam
